#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Package frozen screen source and its bounded execution receipt into JSON."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def read_text(path: str) -> str:
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--source-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--packer-source", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--packer-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--stdout", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--stderr", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--exit", type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--elapsed-seconds", type=float, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    source_bytes = Path(args.source).read_bytes()
    source_hash = hashlib.sha256(source_bytes).hexdigest()
    if source_hash != args.source_sha256:
        raise SystemExit("frozen source hash mismatch")
    packer_bytes = Path(args.packer_source).read_bytes()
    packer_hash = hashlib.sha256(packer_bytes).hexdigest()
    if packer_hash != args.packer_sha256:
        raise SystemExit("receipt packer source hash mismatch")
    stdout = read_text(args.stdout)
    stderr = read_text(args.stderr)
    parsed = json.loads(stdout)
    record = {
        "task": "/root/adapted_grid_control",
        "scope": "bounded falsification screen for one uniform arbitrary-N candidate; no fixed-count LRC claim",
        "candidate": {
            "time_grid": "t=sum_i k_i/(N*v_i)",
            "coefficients": "0<=k_i<N",
            "phases": "ordinary",
            "interval_origin": 0,
            "closed_target": "1/N",
        },
        "frozen_executable_source": {
            "path_at_execution": args.source,
            "encoding": "utf-8",
            "bytes": source_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
            "sha256_before_execution": source_hash,
        },
        "frozen_receipt_packer_source": {
            "path_at_execution": args.packer_source,
            "encoding": "utf-8",
            "bytes": packer_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
            "sha256_before_execution": packer_hash,
        },
        "execution": {
            "argv": ["python3", "-B", args.source, "--n4-max", "20", "--n5-max", "16"],
            "input_domain": {
                "first": "N=4; all increasing triples from 1..20",
                "second_if_needed": "N=5; all increasing quadruples from 1..16",
                "stop_rule": "stop at the first tuple whose entire grid misses the closed target",
            },
            "exit_code": args.exit,
            "elapsed_seconds": args.elapsed_seconds,
            "stdout": stdout,
            "stderr": stderr,
            "stdout_bytes": len(stdout.encode("utf-8")),
            "stderr_bytes": len(stderr.encode("utf-8")),
        },
        "result": parsed,
        "delivery_metrics": {
            "check_kind": "python",
            "first_check_success": args.exit == 0,
            "worker_repair_rounds": 0,
            "worker_elapsed_seconds": args.elapsed_seconds,
            "usage": None,
            "astra_repair_rounds": 0,
            "astra_repair_lines": 0,
            "evidencepath": "research/astra-adapted-grid-control.json",
        },
    }
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
